# **How we transformed Laxmi Computers with Swipe – A simple billing solution that changed everything**


I am Mukesh Kumar, and along with my brother, i operate Laxmi Computers located in Gowlidoddy. This journey, however, did not start one day out of the blue — it began with an employment opportunity.


In Begum Bazar Abids, there is a mobile shop where i started working. There is where i learned about customer handling, stock control and to some degree billing. Gradually, those small sages became the building blocks for something considerable.


After gaining some experience, i met my brother and we decided — **“Let’s open our shop.”**


That’s how Laxmi Computers was born.


But starting a business is one thing. Running it smoothly? That’s where the real challenge begins.


Our biggest issue? **billing.**


We were constantly asking ourselves:


“Where do i make bills?”


“How do i manage so many customers?”


“What if we make a mistake while writing it down?”


Then came **Swipe.**


One of our friends explained everything about this app — how it works, what it does, and how it could solve all our problems. We downloaded it, tried it, and instantly realised:


**This is the billing solution we were looking for.**


Within no time, we learnt how to make bills using Swipe. It wasn’t complicated. It was clear, fast, and fun to use. Slowly, our confidence increased — and so did our customers.


The advancements in the billing system Swipe aided us year on year. And with every improvement, customer satisfaction.


The clarity of record-keeping and professional appearance, alongside prompt provision of receipts, made customers content.


Our workflow was revolutionised through a single mobile application.


Our business outlook is now consistently improving while being established and trusted by many.


Manual bill crafting and calculations are not our concern, as all we have to do is open Swipe, input the information, and everything is sorted efficiently–swiftly and cleanly.


## **Final words from Laxmi Computers**


Running a business isn’t easy. But finding the right tools can make it simpler. Swipe gave us the support we didn’t know we needed — and it’s now a part of our daily work.


If you’re someone like us — running a shop, dealing with billing problems, and trying to keep things organised —[try Swipe](https://getswipe.in/) **.**
